summary: Read the citation count of each paper by one researcher. Every count is a non-negative integer, and N is the paper total. Find the largest integer h such that at least h papers each have h or more citations, and every other paper has at most h citations. Write that h. When several integers satisfy the rule, keep only the largest one.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
